title: A week of every train in Kuala Lumpur
description:
A week of every train in Kuala Lumpur, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds. The feed has no route shapes for the long-distance ETS and airport ERT trains, so they are left out.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Kuala Lumpur city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Kelana Jaya, Ampang lines, Kajang, Putrajaya, Monorail and KTM, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 109 trains, Monday at 8:37 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable.
